
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/aqi00/p/20342058" title="发布于 2026-06-06 12:11">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">15天学会AI应用开发（四）根据Token长度截断历史对话</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<span data-cke-copybin-start="1"><span data-cke-copybin-start="1">​</span></span><span id="cke_bm_218S">上一篇文章说到按照消息数量来截断历史对话，这种方式有个问题，就是每次对话的内容可长可短，导致固定消息数量的对话内容忽长忽短。</span>
<p><span id="cke_bm_218S"> 历史对话内容不光要存入数据库，还要作为初始提示词发给下次新会话的大模型。太长的提示词不仅冗余，还会消耗大量Token，让用户钱包快速缩水。太短的提示词容纳的信息量不足，难以起到充分记忆的功能。</span></p>
<h1>一、为什么统计Token个数而非文字个数</h1>
<p>改进方式是按照文字长度来截断历史对话，不过字跟字又有所不同，不如“猪”是个单字词，而“鹦鹉”是个双字词。对于大模型来说，“猪”和“鹦鹉”具有同等权重，它们都占用一个Token，也就是词元。所以，更好的办法是统计Token数量，而非统计文字数量。</p>
<p>Token不是单个字、也不是单个字母，而是大模型训练时固定好的“最小词块”。早期的AI库主要适配英文，常用单词、词根、词缀直接就是一个Token。对于中文则没有完整常用中文预制词块，大多只能拆成偏旁、笔画、字节片段。</p>
<p>原因是传统的Token分词器采用BPE算法，该算法属于字节级对子压缩，它的底层是按UTF-8编码的字节来切分，不是按中文语义切分。由于每个中文的UTF-8编码固定占用3个字节，而BPE分词器是按字节流拆分、合并成词块，因此3字节的中文很难刚好凑成1个Token。常用汉字还能凑成1个Token，生僻字、复杂字基本拆成2个Token。</p>
<p>可见传统的Token分词器极其违背常识，竟然还能将1个中文拆成两个Token，如此倒翻天罡，敢情是歧视中文用户吧？所以我们的国内开发者挺身而出，开发了中文分词库，能够依据习惯把中文句子切分为各个词语，使得Token数量小于文字数量，这才提高了中文大模型的效率。</p>
<h1>二、传统的Token数量统计方式</h1>
<p>传统的Token分词器依赖于tiktoken库，在编写Python代码前，要先在命令行执行下面的pip安装命令：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="8" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22pip%20install%20tiktoken%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">pip install tiktoken</code></pre>
</div>
<p>然后编写下面的Python分词测试代码：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="7" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22import%20tiktoken%5Cn%5Cntext%20%3D%20%5C%22%E7%8C%AA%E5%92%8C%E9%B9%A6%E9%B9%89%E4%B8%A4%E7%A7%8D%E5%8A%A8%E7%89%A9%EF%BC%8C%E4%BD%A0%E6%9B%B4%E5%96%9C%E6%AC%A2%E5%93%AA%E4%B8%AA%EF%BC%9F%5C%22%5Cnlen_text%20%3D%20len(text)%5Cnprint(%5C%22%E6%96%87%E5%AD%97%E9%95%BF%E5%BA%A6%E4%B8%BA%5C%22%2C%20len_text)%5Cnencoder%20%3D%20tiktoken.encoding_for_model(%5C%22gpt-3.5-turbo%5C%22)%5Cnlen_token%20%3D%20len(encoder.encode(text))%5Cnprint(%5C%22token%E9%95%BF%E5%BA%A6%E4%B8%BA%5C%22%2C%20len_token)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">import tiktoken

text = "猪和鹦鹉两种动物，你更喜欢哪个？"
len_text = len(text)
print("文字长度为", len_text)
encoder = tiktoken.encoding_for_model("gpt-3.5-turbo")
len_token = len(encoder.encode(text))
print("token长度为", len_token)</code></pre>
</div>
<p>运行上面的Python代码，输出日志结果如下：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="6" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22%E6%96%87%E5%AD%97%E9%95%BF%E5%BA%A6%E4%B8%BA%2016%5Cntoken%E9%95%BF%E5%BA%A6%E4%B8%BA%2025%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">文字长度为 16
token长度为 25</code></pre>
</div>
<p>总共16个字符的中文，使用传统的Token分词器，竟然统计得到25个token，不合理简直太不合理了。</p>
<h1>三、中文Token数量的统计方式</h1>
<p>中文的Token分词器依赖于jieba库，在编写Python代码前，要先在命令行执行下面pip安装命令：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="5" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22pip%20install%20jieba%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">pip install jieba</code></pre>
</div>
<p>然后编写下面的Python分词测试代码：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="4" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22import%20jieba%5Cn%5Cntext%20%3D%20%5C%22%E7%8C%AA%E5%92%8C%E9%B9%A6%E9%B9%89%E4%B8%A4%E7%A7%8D%E5%8A%A8%E7%89%A9%EF%BC%8C%E4%BD%A0%E6%9B%B4%E5%96%9C%E6%AC%A2%E5%93%AA%E4%B8%AA%EF%BC%9F%5C%22%5Cnlen_text%20%3D%20len(text)%5Cnprint(%5C%22%E6%96%87%E5%AD%97%E9%95%BF%E5%BA%A6%E4%B8%BA%5C%22%2C%20len_text)%5Cnwords%20%3D%20jieba.lcut(text)%5Cnwords%20%3D%20%5Bw%20for%20w%20in%20words%20if%20w.strip()%5D%5Cnlen_token%20%3D%20len(words)%5Cnprint(%5C%22token%E9%95%BF%E5%BA%A6%E4%B8%BA%5C%22%2C%20len_token)%5Cnprint(words)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">import jieba

text = "猪和鹦鹉两种动物，你更喜欢哪个？"
len_text = len(text)
print("文字长度为", len_text)
words = jieba.lcut(text)
words = [w for w in words if w.strip()]
len_token = len(words)
print("token长度为", len_token)
print(words)</code></pre>
</div>
<p>运行上面的Python代码，输出日志结果如下：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="3" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22%E6%96%87%E5%AD%97%E9%95%BF%E5%BA%A6%E4%B8%BA%2016%5Cntoken%E9%95%BF%E5%BA%A6%E4%B8%BA%2011%5Cn%5B'%E7%8C%AA'%2C%20'%E5%92%8C'%2C%20'%E9%B9%A6%E9%B9%89'%2C%20'%E4%B8%A4%E7%A7%8D'%2C%20'%E5%8A%A8%E7%89%A9'%2C%20'%EF%BC%8C'%2C%20'%E4%BD%A0'%2C%20'%E6%9B%B4'%2C%20'%E5%96%9C%E6%AC%A2'%2C%20'%E5%93%AA%E4%B8%AA'%2C%20'%EF%BC%9F'%5D%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">文字长度为 16
token长度为 11
['猪', '和', '鹦鹉', '两种', '动物', '，', '你', '更', '喜欢', '哪个', '？']</code></pre>
</div>
<p>总共16个字符的中文，中文传统的Token分词器，精简后统计得到11个Token，可见相较传统分词器大幅瘦身。</p>
<h1>四、根据Token数量精简上下文</h1>
<p>接下来将以Python代码演示如何按照Token数量来截断早期的上下文（即问答内容）。下面是只保留100个Token的Python代码例子：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="2" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22import%20jieba%5Cn%5Cnclass%20ContextManager%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20def%20__init__(self)%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20%E5%AF%B9%E8%AF%9D%E5%8E%86%E5%8F%B2%E4%B8%8A%E4%B8%8B%E6%96%87%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20self.context%20%3D%20%5B%5D%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20%E4%B8%8A%E4%B8%8B%E6%96%87%E7%9A%84%E6%9C%80%E5%A4%A7Token%E6%95%B0%E9%87%8F%EF%BC%8C%E8%AE%BE%E5%B0%8F%E4%B8%80%E7%82%B9%EF%BC%8C%E6%96%B9%E4%BE%BF%E7%9C%8B%E5%88%B0%E6%88%AA%E6%96%AD%E6%95%88%E6%9E%9C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20self.MAX_TOKENS%20%3D%2050%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20%E8%AE%A1%E7%AE%97%E5%8D%95%E6%9D%A1%E6%B6%88%E6%81%AF%E7%9A%84Token%E6%95%B0%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20def%20count_tokens(self%2C%20text)%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20words%20%3D%20jieba.lcut(text)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20words%20%3D%20%5Bw%20for%20w%20in%20words%20if%20w.strip()%5D%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20return%20len(words)%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20%E8%AE%A1%E7%AE%97%E6%95%B4%E4%B8%AA%E4%B8%8A%E4%B8%8B%E6%96%87%E6%80%BBToken%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20def%20total_context_tokens(self)%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20return%20sum(self.count_tokens(msg%5B%5C%22content%5C%22%5D)%20for%20msg%20in%20self.context)%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20%E6%A0%B8%E5%BF%83%EF%BC%9A%E6%8C%89Token%E8%87%AA%E5%8A%A8%E6%88%AA%E6%96%AD%EF%BC%88%E5%88%A0%E6%8E%89%E6%9C%80%E6%97%A9%E7%9A%84%EF%BC%8C%E7%9B%B4%E5%88%B0%E4%B8%8D%E8%B6%85%E9%99%90%EF%BC%89%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20def%20truncate_context(self)%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20while%20self.total_context_tokens()%20%3E%20self.MAX_TOKENS%20and%20len(self.context)%20%3E%200%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20removed_msg%20%3D%20self.context.pop(0)%20%C2%A0%23%20%E5%88%A0%E9%99%A4%E6%9C%80%E6%97%A9%E4%B8%80%E6%9D%A1%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20print(f%5C%22%5B%E6%88%AA%E6%96%AD%5D%20%E5%88%A0%E6%8E%89%E6%9C%80%E6%97%A9%E5%AF%B9%E8%AF%9D%EF%BC%9A%7Bremoved_msg%5B'content'%5D%5B%3A20%5D%7D...%5C%22)%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20%E6%B7%BB%E5%8A%A0%E6%96%B0%E6%B6%88%E6%81%AF%20%E2%86%92%20%E8%87%AA%E5%8A%A8%E6%88%AA%E6%96%AD%20%E2%86%92%20%E8%BF%94%E5%9B%9E%E5%AE%8C%E6%95%B4%E4%B8%8A%E4%B8%8B%E6%96%87%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20def%20add_message(self%2C%20role%2C%20content)%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20self.context.append(%7B%5C%22role%5C%22%3A%20role%2C%20%5C%22content%5C%22%3A%20content%7D)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20self.truncate_context()%20%C2%A0%23%20%E6%88%AA%E6%96%AD%EF%BC%81%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20return%20self.context%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20%E6%8B%BC%E6%8E%A5%E6%88%90%E7%BB%99%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E7%9A%84%E5%AE%8C%E6%95%B4Prompt%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20def%20get_full_prompt(self)%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20prompt%20%3D%20%5C%22%5C%22%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20for%20msg%20in%20self.context%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20prompt%20%2B%3D%20f%5C%22%7Bmsg%5B'role'%5D%7D%EF%BC%9A%7Bmsg%5B'content'%5D%7D%5C%5Cn%5C%22%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20return%20prompt%5Cn%5Cn%23%20%E6%A8%A1%E6%8B%9F%E5%A4%9A%E8%BD%AE%E5%AF%B9%E8%AF%9D%E6%B5%8B%E8%AF%95%5Cnif%20__name__%20%3D%3D%20%5C%22__main__%5C%22%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20ai%20%3D%20ContextManager()%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20%E8%BF%9E%E7%BB%AD%E5%8F%91%E9%95%BF%E6%96%87%E6%9C%AC%EF%BC%8C%E8%A7%82%E5%AF%9F%E8%87%AA%E5%8A%A8%E6%88%AA%E6%96%AD%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20chat_records%20%3D%20%5B%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20(%5C%22user%5C%22%2C%20%5C%22%E6%8E%A8%E8%8D%90%E4%B8%80%E6%9C%AC%E5%85%B3%E4%BA%8E%E5%8E%86%E5%8F%B2%E7%9A%84%E4%B9%A6%EF%BC%8C%E8%A6%81%E5%86%85%E5%AE%B9%E8%AF%A6%E7%BB%86%E3%80%81%E9%80%82%E5%90%88%E5%85%A5%E9%97%A8%5C%22)%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20(%5C%22ai%5C%22%2C%20%5C%22%E6%8E%A8%E8%8D%90%E3%80%8A%E6%98%8E%E6%9C%9D%E9%82%A3%E4%BA%9B%E4%BA%8B%E5%84%BF%E3%80%8B%EF%BC%8C%E9%80%9A%E4%BF%97%E5%A5%BD%E8%AF%BB%5C%22)%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20(%5C%22user%5C%22%2C%20%5C%22%E6%9C%89%E6%B2%A1%E6%9C%89%E5%9B%BD%E5%A4%96%E5%8E%86%E5%8F%B2%E7%9A%84%EF%BC%9F%E6%AF%94%E5%A6%82%E6%AC%A7%E6%B4%B2%E5%8F%B2%5C%22)%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20(%5C%22ai%5C%22%2C%20%5C%22%E6%8E%A8%E8%8D%90%E3%80%8A%E6%AC%A7%E6%B4%B2%E9%80%9A%E5%8F%B2%E4%B8%8A%E4%B8%8B%E4%B8%A4%E5%8D%83%E5%B9%B4%E3%80%8B%5C%22)%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20(%5C%22user%5C%22%2C%20%5C%22%E5%A4%AA%E9%95%BF%E4%BA%86%E6%9C%89%E6%B2%A1%E6%9C%89%E6%9B%B4%E7%9F%AD%E7%9A%84%EF%BC%9F%E6%88%91%E5%8F%AA%E6%83%B3%E5%BF%AB%E9%80%9F%E4%BA%86%E8%A7%A3%E6%A0%B8%E5%BF%83%E8%84%89%E7%BB%9C%5C%22)%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20(%5C%22ai%5C%22%2C%20%5C%22%E9%82%A3%E7%9C%8B%E3%80%8A%E6%9E%81%E7%AE%80%E6%AC%A7%E6%B4%B2%E5%8F%B2%E3%80%8B%E7%B2%BE%E7%AE%80%E7%89%88%EF%BC%8C100%E9%A1%B5%E6%90%9E%E5%AE%9A%5C%22)%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20(%5C%22user%5C%22%2C%20%5C%22%E5%A5%BD%EF%BC%8C%E5%86%8D%E6%8E%A8%E8%8D%90%E4%B8%80%E6%9C%AC%E7%B1%BB%E4%BC%BC%E9%A3%8E%E6%A0%BC%E7%9A%84%E7%BE%8E%E5%9B%BD%E5%8E%86%E5%8F%B2%E4%B9%A6%5C%22)%2C%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5D%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20print(%5C%22%3D%3D%3D%20%E5%BC%80%E5%A7%8B%E5%AF%B9%E8%AF%9D%20%3D%3D%3D%5C%22)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20for%20role%2C%20content%20in%20chat_records%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20ai.add_message(role%2C%20content)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20print(f%5C%22%5C%5Cn%5B%7Brole%7D%5D%20%7Bcontent%7D%5C%22)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20print(f%5C%22%E5%BD%93%E5%89%8D%E6%80%BBToken%EF%BC%9A%7Bai.total_context_tokens()%7D%20%2F%20%7Bai.MAX_TOKENS%7D%5C%22)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20print(%5C%22---%20%E5%BD%93%E5%89%8D%E4%BF%9D%E7%95%99%E7%9A%84%E4%B8%8A%E4%B8%8B%E6%96%87%20---%5C%22)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20print(ai.get_full_prompt())%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">import jieba

class ContextManager:
&nbsp; &nbsp; def __init__(self):
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; # 对话历史上下文
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; self.context = []
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; # 上下文的最大Token数量，设小一点，方便看到截断效果
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; self.MAX_TOKENS = 50

&nbsp; &nbsp; # 计算单条消息的Token数
&nbsp; &nbsp; def count_tokens(self, text):
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; words = jieba.lcut(text)
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; words = [w for w in words if w.strip()]
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; return len(words)

&nbsp; &nbsp; # 计算整个上下文总Token
&nbsp; &nbsp; def total_context_tokens(self):
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; return sum(self.count_tokens(msg["content"]) for msg in self.context)

&nbsp; &nbsp; # 核心：按Token自动截断（删掉最早的，直到不超限）
&nbsp; &nbsp; def truncate_context(self):
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; while self.total_context_tokens() &gt; self.MAX_TOKENS and len(self.context) &gt; 0:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; removed_msg = self.context.pop(0) &nbsp;# 删除最早一条
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; print(f"[截断] 删掉最早对话：{removed_msg['content'][:20]}...")

&nbsp; &nbsp; # 添加新消息 → 自动截断 → 返回完整上下文
&nbsp; &nbsp; def add_message(self, role, content):
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; self.context.append({"role": role, "content": content})
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; self.truncate_context() &nbsp;# 截断！
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; return self.context

&nbsp; &nbsp; # 拼接成给模型的完整Prompt
&nbsp; &nbsp; def get_full_prompt(self):
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; prompt = ""
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; for msg in self.context:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; prompt += f"{msg['role']}：{msg['content']}\n"
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; return prompt

# 模拟多轮对话测试
if __name__ == "__main__":
&nbsp; &nbsp; ai = ContextManager()

&nbsp; &nbsp; # 连续发长文本，观察自动截断
&nbsp; &nbsp; chat_records = [
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ("user", "推荐一本关于历史的书，要内容详细、适合入门"),
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ("ai", "推荐《明朝那些事儿》，通俗好读"),
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ("user", "有没有国外历史的？比如欧洲史"),
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ("ai", "推荐《欧洲通史上下两千年》"),
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ("user", "太长了有没有更短的？我只想快速了解核心脉络"),
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ("ai", "那看《极简欧洲史》精简版，100页搞定"),
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ("user", "好，再推荐一本类似风格的美国历史书"),
&nbsp; &nbsp; ]

&nbsp; &nbsp; print("=== 开始对话 ===")
&nbsp; &nbsp; for role, content in chat_records:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ai.add_message(role, content)
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; print(f"\n[{role}] {content}")
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; print(f"当前总Token：{ai.total_context_tokens()} / {ai.MAX_TOKENS}")
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; print("--- 当前保留的上下文 ---")
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; print(ai.get_full_prompt())</code></pre>
</div>
<p>运行上面的Python代码，观察到最后一轮的输出日志：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="1" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22%5Buser%5D%20%E5%A5%BD%EF%BC%8C%E5%86%8D%E6%8E%A8%E8%8D%90%E4%B8%80%E6%9C%AC%E7%B1%BB%E4%BC%BC%E9%A3%8E%E6%A0%BC%E7%9A%84%E7%BE%8E%E5%9B%BD%E5%8E%86%E5%8F%B2%E4%B9%A6%5Cn%E5%BD%93%E5%89%8D%E6%80%BBToken%EF%BC%9A44%20%2F%2050%5Cn---%20%E5%BD%93%E5%89%8D%E4%BF%9D%E7%95%99%E7%9A%84%E4%B8%8A%E4%B8%8B%E6%96%87%20---%5Cnai%EF%BC%9A%E6%8E%A8%E8%8D%90%E3%80%8A%E6%AC%A7%E6%B4%B2%E9%80%9A%E5%8F%B2%E4%B8%8A%E4%B8%8B%E4%B8%A4%E5%8D%83%E5%B9%B4%E3%80%8B%5Cnuser%EF%BC%9A%E5%A4%AA%E9%95%BF%E4%BA%86%E6%9C%89%E6%B2%A1%E6%9C%89%E6%9B%B4%E7%9F%AD%E7%9A%84%EF%BC%9F%E6%88%91%E5%8F%AA%E6%83%B3%E5%BF%AB%E9%80%9F%E4%BA%86%E8%A7%A3%E6%A0%B8%E5%BF%83%E8%84%89%E7%BB%9C%5Cnai%EF%BC%9A%E9%82%A3%E7%9C%8B%E3%80%8A%E6%9E%81%E7%AE%80%E6%AC%A7%E6%B4%B2%E5%8F%B2%E3%80%8B%E7%B2%BE%E7%AE%80%E7%89%88%EF%BC%8C100%E9%A1%B5%E6%90%9E%E5%AE%9A%5Cnuser%EF%BC%9A%E5%A5%BD%EF%BC%8C%E5%86%8D%E6%8E%A8%E8%8D%90%E4%B8%80%E6%9C%AC%E7%B1%BB%E4%BC%BC%E9%A3%8E%E6%A0%BC%E7%9A%84%E7%BE%8E%E5%9B%BD%E5%8E%86%E5%8F%B2%E4%B9%A6%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">[user] 好，再推荐一本类似风格的美国历史书
当前总Token：44 / 50
--- 当前保留的上下文 ---
ai：推荐《欧洲通史上下两千年》
user：太长了有没有更短的？我只想快速了解核心脉络
ai：那看《极简欧洲史》精简版，100页搞定
user：好，再推荐一本类似风格的美国历史书</code></pre>
</div>
<p>可见最后一轮根据Token限制删去了较早的对话记录，使得总Token数维持在50以内，这就节约了下次会话的初始Token消耗。</p>
<p>本系列的AI应用开发文章目录为《<span class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_inline cke_widget_csdnlink cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="a" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="0" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">15天学会AI应用开发全目录（零基础小白，零Token消耗）》。</span></p>
